research.topic: Eat the frog — tackling your hardest/most important task first
research.hook: What if I told you that doing the hardest thing first and then napping can double your exam scores? Try it for 3 days and watch the magic happen.
research.tip: Use the 50/5 Frog‑First Routine: 50 min on your toughest task, 5‑min stretch break, then a 20‑min power nap before the next work block.
